column1: # impact_proof.tsv -- THE PROOF A LANDING OWES, BY WHAT IT TOUCHES (DESIGN-PLAN box-scheduler step 13, CTO-496; the president 2026-11-05, row
# box-scheduler-step-13-the-landing-proof-is-sized-by-the-change-impact-set-cto-496; the design text is the shared-box skill's DESIGN section 8:
# "the proof is sized by the change-impact set (a Makefile line owes the build gate, not eight smokes)").
# util_impact_set.py --root <repo> --commit HEAD --proof reads THIS table and prints PROOF arms=A smokes=S gates=G ... then one ARM line per command.
# FORMAT, whole-line comments only, TAB-separated:   repo<TAB>carrier<TAB>owes
#   repo     SCRIP, harness, corpus or .github (the root's directory name, or --repo)
#   carrier  a file (Makefile), a directory with a trailing slash (src/), a glob over the repo-relative path (scripts/test_gate_*.sh, *.md),
#            or `.` the repo's catch-all. THE LONGEST CARRIER THAT MATCHES A TOUCHED FILE DECIDES ITS ROW; a file no row names falls to the catch-all,
#            so an unmapped file owes MORE proof, never less (the safe direction; the area map's own refusal still guards src/).
#   owes     a comma list of: -  build  preflight  area  refgates  buildgates  self
#     build       ARM build:      cd SCRIP && make -j8
#     preflight   ARM preflight:  cd SCRIP && make preflight   (the cheap hermetic arms, no build; the law's per-landing verdict names it)
#     area        the file is a src/ carrier: the carrier map (test_area_smoke.sh --list-only) names the languages; ARM area, and ARM smoke
#                 test_smoke_<lang>.sh for each language that has one; a SHARED NODE (a * row) owes the declared shared-smokes instead
#     refgates    ARM gate for each WIRED test_gate_*.sh whose source names this file's repo-relative path (a path literal, never the basename and
#                 never the parent directory: MEASURED 2026-11-05 on the president's worktree, src/runtime/posix_leaves.c names 0 gates by path and
#                 150 by its directory, so a directory match would size every runtime landing at the whole set)
#     buildgates  ARM gate for each gate the @ buildgates directive names (a Makefile line is read by 54 gates, so it owes the declared few)
#     self        the file is a gate script: ARM gate for it, wired or not, since its lander must run it
#   `-` owes nothing: a prose or record file.
# DIRECTIVES, repo column `@`:   @<TAB>buildgates<TAB>gate names      @<TAB>shared-smokes<TAB>language names (test_smoke_<name>.sh)
#   shared-smokes is clause (8) of RULES.md, ONE TESTING OFFICER, the eight per-language smokes MEASURED there at 8-20 s in all.
#   A name a directive gives that is not a file in the scripts directory REFUSES rc 2: a missing arm is never dropped quietly.
# ONLY WIRED GATES ARE OWED (gate_wiring.tsv): a TASK gate is debt and reads red by design, a RULING gate is deliberately out of make test; the PROOF
#   line counts the ones it left out as unwired=N.
# HYPOTHESIS, marked: a gate that reads a file through a lib_ helper or a directory sweep names no path literal and is not found by refgates; that
#   blind spot is the one preflight_arms.txt names for its own grep, and the eight smokes and the coo's lap are what cover a shared node.
